import pandas as pd

# Read the source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_52/training_0.csv"
df_source = pd.read_csv(source_path, index_col=0)

# Perform the group by operation on 'condition' and sum the 'click' column
df_grouped = df_source.groupby('condition', as_index=False)['click'].sum()

# Rename the aggregated column 'click' to '0' to match the target schema
df_grouped.rename(columns={'click': '0'}, inplace=True)

# Ensure the data types match the target schema: both columns as integer
df_grouped['condition'] = df_grouped['condition'].astype(int)
df_grouped['0'] = df_grouped['0'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target CSV file without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_52/target_multisource.csv"
df_grouped.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
